events.title: McDonald's Pokémon Happy Meal cards begin
events.note: McDonald's announced the November 10 start. The December 14 end is reported, and supplies can run out sooner. The set has 15 cards.

events.title: Mega Greninja ex League Battle Deck street date
events.note: Most trackers list November 13. ICv2 lists November 11.
covers: Mega Greninja ex League Battle Deck

events.title: Pokémon Center Delta Reign preorders ship
events.note: Pokémon Center's estimated-ship table says mid-November after checkout went down for about six days. Don't list these on eBay until yours has shipped.

events.title: Black Friday
events.note: Sales start earlier. On Walmart, check for "Sold and shipped by Walmart": many "deals" are marketplace sellers priced above MSRP.

events.title: 30th Celebration tins and Binder Collection street date
events.note: Tins (Greninja ex, Sylveon ex) are $21.99. The Binder Collection is $31.99 and was delayed from October 2.

events.title: Likely Pokémon Center preorders for Flowing Fists
events.note: Calculated, not announced. Pitch Black and Delta Reign preorders opened 37 days before street date and Chaos Rising 39. Holiday week could shift it, and the February 5 set date isn't confirmed.

events.title: Valentine's Box street date
events.note: 20 mini packs of 3 cards each. PokeBeach reports January 15, while one outlet said January 27.

events.title: Flowing Fists prerelease events
events.note: Reported by PokeBeach. Pokémon hasn't announced it.

events.title: Flowing Fists street date
events.note: First main set of 2027, the English version of Japan's Aura Seeker. Pokémon hasn't confirmed the date, and no Pokémon Center ETB is confirmed yet.

events.title: Mega Rayquaza ex Premium Tournament Collection street date
events.note: Pokémon's product page gives the date. The $49.99 price comes from reporting, because the page doesn't list one.

undated.title: Mega Forces Tins
undated.note: Delayed from August 28 with no new date. Retailers expect late 2026.
